ownership.intro: Hand an area of the shop's data to an external system, or take it back. While an external system owns an area, it is the only thing that writes it: the fields it fills are read-only here, and the shop's own way in is turned off. While nobody owns it, the shop is in charge and automated updates are refused.

areaDescription.catalog: Product names, categories, prices and stock. Descriptions, photos, attributes, documents and what is paired with what stay yours either way.

ownership.statusOwnEffect: File uploads work, and automated updates are refused.

ownership.takeWarning: The external system's updates will be refused from its next attempt, and whatever it sends while it is refused is not kept. Hand the catalog back when you are done.
ownership.handConfirm: Hand the catalog to an external system?
ownership.handWarning: File uploads stop working, and names, categories, prices and stock become read-only in the catalog editor. Any file already uploaded and waiting can no longer be applied.
ownership.error: Something went wrong changing this. Please try again.
ownership.fieldLocked: The catalog is managed by an external system, so this is set there rather than here. To edit it in the shop, take the catalog back under Data ownership in the admin panel.
ownership.fieldLockedShort: Set by the external system that manages the catalog.
ownership.categoryHasProducts: This category still has products in it. While the catalog is managed by an external system, products cannot be moved between categories here — empty it in that system first, or take the catalog back under Data ownership in the admin panel.
ownership.productDelete: The catalog is managed by an external system, so what it contains is set there. Remove this product in that system, or take the catalog back under Data ownership in the admin panel.
ownership.productCreate: The catalog is managed by an external system, so new products are added there. To add one in the shop, take the catalog back under Data ownership in the admin panel.
ownership.tierKeyLocked: The catalog is managed by an external system, so this price list's key is set there. The name is yours to change either way, and you can still add a price list or remove an unused one.
